title: Best Console for GTA 6: PS5, PS5 Pro, Series X or Series S, Plus Which Edition to Buy
summary: Compare PS5, PS5 Pro, Xbox Series X and Series S to pick the best console for GTA 6, plus Standard vs Ultimate editions and the Nov 12 preload.
body_markdown:
Picking the right console for GTA 6 comes down to four things: storage, TV output, the controller you like, and the friends you play with. According to[Rockstar's official GTA VI page](https://www.rockstargames.com/VI?utm_source=insider&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=insider_article_best-console-for-gta-6-ps5-ps5-pro-series-x-or-series-s-plus-which-edition-to-buy) , Grand Theft Auto VI launches on **November 19, 2026** , on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S only. However, no PC version has been announced. That leaves about six weeks to choose a system, pick an edition, and make room for a large download. This guide compares the PS5, PS5 Pro, Xbox Series X and Xbox Series S for GTA 6. Next, it breaks down the Standard and Ultimate editions, the preorder bonus, and the GTA+ trial. Finally, it covers the November 12 preload so you can play the minute the game unlocks.


## Quick Answer: Which Console for GTA 6 Fits You?


**The PS5 Pro and Xbox Series X are the strongest picks, while the 512 GB Xbox Series S is the budget option with the tightest storage.** Every current console runs the game, so the real decision is about headroom, display output and ecosystem.


First, if you already own one of these systems, you probably don't need to switch. However, buyers starting fresh should compare what each machine offers before launch day, and our[PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X buying guide](https://www.newegg.com/insider/playstation-5-and-xbox-series-x-buying-guide?utm_source=insider&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=insider_article_best-console-for-gta-6-ps5-ps5-pro-series-x-or-series-s-plus-which-edition-to-buy) covers the hardware basics. The table below sums up the key differences.

Shoppers who want PlayStation can browse[PS5 consoles and bundles](https://www.newegg.com/p/pl?d=ps5+console&utm_source=insider&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=insider_article_best-console-for-gta-6-ps5-ps5-pro-series-x-or-series-s-plus-which-edition-to-buy) to compare the Slim and Digital models. However, prices shift often, so compare current listings rather than relying on old launch figures.


## PS5 vs PS5 Pro: What "Pro Enhanced" Means for GTA 6


**The PlayStation Store lists GTA 6 as PS5 Pro Enhanced, but Rockstar has not detailed what the Pro version adds.** In practice, that label means the developer has tuned the game to use the Pro's extra GPU power in some way.


On other Pro Enhanced titles, that usually translates to sharper image quality, steadier performance, or both. For GTA 6, though, neither resolution nor frame-rate modes are confirmed for any console, as our breakdown of[what resolution and frame rate to expect from GTA 6 on PS5 Pro](https://www.newegg.com/insider/gta-6-on-ps5-pro-what-resolution-and-frame-rate-can-you-expect?utm_source=insider&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=insider_article_best-console-for-gta-6-ps5-ps5-pro-series-x-or-series-s-plus-which-edition-to-buy) explains. Buy the Pro for its known strengths, not for promised GTA 6 numbers that don't exist yet.


Even so, those known strengths still matter. The PS5 Pro ships with 2 TB of storage, double the 1 TB of the PS5 Slim. That extra space alone makes it a comfortable console for GTA 6 if you also keep several other large games installed. In addition, the Pro has no built-in disc drive, which matters less than you might think, as the boxed section below explains.


On the other hand, the standard PS5 remains a solid choice for most players. It runs the same game, supports 4K output at up to 120 Hz on compatible TVs, and accepts the same storage upgrades. If you are weighing the two, compare[PS5 Pro listings](https://www.newegg.com/p/pl?d=ps5+pro&utm_source=insider&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=insider_article_best-console-for-gta-6-ps5-ps5-pro-series-x-or-series-s-plus-which-edition-to-buy) against the Slim and decide whether the extra storage and GPU headroom justify the gap for you.


## Xbox Series X vs Series S: The 512 GB Question


**The Xbox Series X is the full-power Xbox console for GTA 6, while the 512 GB Series S trades resolution and storage for a smaller size and lower cost.** Both run the game, but the Series S needs more planning.


First, the core issue is space. Rockstar has not announced the file size. Figures of 150 GB, 200 GB and even 300 GB circulate online, but all of them are unconfirmed rumors. Even so, it is wise to plan for roughly 150-200 GB or more of free space. On a 512 GB Series S, system software already claims a large slice of the drive. As a result, GTA 6 could take up most of what remains.


Second, the Series S targets lower resolutions than the Series X. It can send a 4K signal to your TV, but it is not built to render games natively at 4K. On a 1440p monitor or a mid-size TV, that difference is less obvious. On a large 4K screen, the Series X has a clear edge.


For many Series S owners, the practical fix is an official expansion card. The[Xbox Storage Expansion Card options](https://www.newegg.com/p/pl?d=xbox+storage+expansion+card&utm_source=insider&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=insider_article_best-console-for-gta-6-ps5-ps5-pro-series-x-or-series-s-plus-which-edition-to-buy) plug into the rear slot and let you play Series X|S games directly from the card. Meanwhile, new buyers who prefer the compact design can look at[Xbox Series S consoles](https://www.newegg.com/p/pl?d=xbox+series+s&utm_source=insider&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=insider_article_best-console-for-gta-6-ps5-ps5-pro-series-x-or-series-s-plus-which-edition-to-buy) , ideally the 1 TB model if storage matters to you.


## Storage Planning on Any Console for GTA 6


**Clear at least 150-200 GB before the November 12 preload, and add storage now if your drive is already close to full.** Each platform handles expansion differently, so follow the right path for your system.


### PS5 and PS5 Pro


Every PS5 model, including the Slim and Pro, has one internal M.2 slot. It accepts a PCIe Gen4 x4 NVMe drive from 250 GB to 8 TB.[Sony's M.2 SSD support page](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/support/hardware/ps5-install-m2-ssd/?utm_source=insider&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=insider_article_best-console-for-gta-6-ps5-ps5-pro-series-x-or-series-s-plus-which-edition-to-buy) recommends a sequential read speed of 5,500 MB/s or faster. The slot fits 2230, 2242, 2260, 2280 and 22110 drives, and a heatsink is recommended. You can shop[NVMe SSDs](https://www.newegg.com/p/pl?d=ssd&utm_source=insider&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=insider_article_best-console-for-gta-6-ps5-ps5-pro-series-x-or-series-s-plus-which-edition-to-buy) by those specs, or narrow the search to[PS5-ready SSDs with heatsinks](https://www.newegg.com/p/pl?d=ps5+ssd+heatsink&utm_source=insider&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=insider_article_best-console-for-gta-6-ps5-ps5-pro-series-x-or-series-s-plus-which-edition-to-buy) . Our[GTA 6 storage guide for PS5 and Xbox](https://www.newegg.com/insider/gta-6-storage-ps5-ssd-xbox-guide?utm_source=insider&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=insider_article_best-console-for-gta-6-ps5-ps5-pro-series-x-or-series-s-plus-which-edition-to-buy) covers specific drive picks in detail. For a wider field, our roundup of the[best NVMe SSDs of 2026](https://www.newegg.com/insider/best-nvme-ssds-2026?utm_source=insider&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=insider_article_best-console-for-gta-6-ps5-ps5-pro-series-x-or-series-s-plus-which-edition-to-buy) adds more options.


### Xbox Series X and Series S


Xbox, however, works differently. Series X|S-optimized games like GTA 6 must run from internal storage or an official expansion card. A USB 3.1 external drive can *store* those games, but it cannot *play* them. But an external drive is still useful. For example, you can park other Series X|S games on a[USB external hard drive](https://www.newegg.com/Hard-Drives/Category/ID-15?utm_source=insider&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=insider_article_best-console-for-gta-6-ps5-ps5-pro-series-x-or-series-s-plus-which-edition-to-buy) and copy them back later. Our guide to the[best external drives for Xbox Series X and PS5](https://www.newegg.com/insider/best-hard-drive-xbox-series-x-ps5-nintendo-switch?utm_source=insider&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=insider_article_best-console-for-gta-6-ps5-ps5-pro-series-x-or-series-s-plus-which-edition-to-buy) can help you choose one. That move frees internal space for GTA 6 without deleting your library.


## 4K Output, HDR and Your TV


**For 4K play, pair a PS5, PS5 Pro or Xbox Series X with an HDMI 2.1 TV that supports 4K at 120 Hz, VRR and ALLM.** Those three features make the biggest visible difference on a modern display.


VRR, or variable refresh rate, lets the TV match the console's output so motion looks smoother. ALLM, or auto low latency mode, switches the TV into game mode on its own. Meanwhile, 4K at 120 Hz requires an HDMI 2.1 port and a cable rated for it, and our explainer on[what HDMI 2.1 is and whether you need it](https://www.newegg.com/insider/what-is-hdmi-2-1-and-do-you-need-it?utm_source=insider&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=insider_article_best-console-for-gta-6-ps5-ps5-pro-series-x-or-series-s-plus-which-edition-to-buy) covers the details. If your TV is a few years old, check the port labels before launch day. Shopping for a new set? Start with our[TV buying guide](https://www.newegg.com/insider/best-tv-buying-guide?utm_source=insider&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=insider_article_best-console-for-gta-6-ps5-ps5-pro-series-x-or-series-s-plus-which-edition-to-buy) .


Next, HDR support differs by platform. Xbox Series X|S supports Dolby Vision gaming, while PS5 uses HDR10. Both look excellent on a good TV. However, if you already own a Dolby Vision set, Xbox gives you one more format to use.


Both PS5 and Xbox Series X also output at 1440p. That makes a[1440p gaming monitor](https://www.newegg.com/p/pl?d=gaming+monitor&utm_source=insider&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=insider_article_best-console-for-gta-6-ps5-ps5-pro-series-x-or-series-s-plus-which-edition-to-buy) a sensible desk setup for players without a big TV. Our guide to the[best 1440p OLED gaming monitors of 2026](https://www.newegg.com/insider/best-1440p-oled-gaming-monitors-in-2026-your-questions-answered?utm_source=insider&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=insider_article_best-console-for-gta-6-ps5-ps5-pro-series-x-or-series-s-plus-which-edition-to-buy) narrows the field. For living rooms, browse[4K gaming TVs with HDMI 2.1](https://www.newegg.com/p/pl?d=4k+gaming+tv&utm_source=insider&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=insider_article_best-console-for-gta-6-ps5-ps5-pro-series-x-or-series-s-plus-which-edition-to-buy) . Also, use the cable that came with your console, or pick up a certified[HDMI 2.1 cable](https://www.newegg.com/p/pl?d=hdmi+2.1+cable&utm_source=insider&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=insider_article_best-console-for-gta-6-ps5-ps5-pro-series-x-or-series-s-plus-which-edition-to-buy) if you need a longer run.


## Ecosystem, Controllers and Subscriptions


**Choose the platform where your friends, your existing game library and your favorite controller already live.** For a single-player launch, those factors often matter more than raw specs.


For example, controllers feel different on each side. The PS5's DualSense offers haptic feedback and adaptive triggers that can add texture to driving and shooting. The Xbox Wireless Controller has a familiar layout, offset sticks and long battery life with AA or rechargeable packs. If you plan long sessions, a spare[DualSense wireless controller](https://www.newegg.com/p/pl?d=dualsense+controller&utm_source=insider&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=insider_article_best-console-for-gta-6-ps5-ps5-pro-series-x-or-series-s-plus-which-edition-to-buy) or an extra[Xbox wireless controller](https://www.newegg.com/p/pl?d=xbox+wireless+controller&utm_source=insider&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=insider_article_best-console-for-gta-6-ps5-ps5-pro-series-x-or-series-s-plus-which-edition-to-buy) keeps one charged and ready.


Next comes the subscription question. Launch listings describe GTA 6 as a single-player experience, and Rockstar has not announced GTA 6 Online. On both consoles, single-player games generally play without a paid online membership. Even so, PlayStation Plus and Xbox Game Pass add perks such as cloud saves and online play in other titles. If you are on the fence, read our take on[whether Xbox Game Pass is worth it](https://www.newegg.com/insider/is-xbox-game-pass-worth-it?utm_source=insider&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=insider_article_best-console-for-gta-6-ps5-ps5-pro-series-x-or-series-s-plus-which-edition-to-buy) . No subscription-library inclusion has been announced for GTA 6, so plan to buy the game outright.


Finally, consider your existing library. Years of purchases on one platform usually stay on that platform. As a result, the best console for GTA 6 is often the one already connected to your account and your friends list.


## Standard vs Ultimate Edition: What the Extra $20 Buys


**The Standard Edition at $79.99 is the complete game, while the $99.99 Ultimate Edition adds single-player extras.** You lose no story content by choosing Standard.


The Ultimate Edition adds extra single-player vehicles, weapons, character styles, businesses and properties. It also includes bonuses such as the 1995 Grotti Cheetah and the PTT Youngin$ Compound. In addition, Standard owners can upgrade to Ultimate later for $20, so you don't have to decide on day one.

### Preorder bonus and the GTA+ free month


In addition, every preorder includes the **Vintage Vice City Pack** . It contains a 1955 Vapid Stanier Sedan with a garage, extra styles and a weapon pattern. Digital preorders also get one free month of GTA+. However, that month **renews as a paid membership unless you cancel it** . Set a calendar reminder a few days before the trial ends if you don't plan to keep it.


## Digital vs Boxed: Every Copy of GTA 6 Is a Download


**The boxed version of GTA 6 contains a download code, not a disc, so every player downloads the full game.** This one detail changes a few buying decisions.


First, a disc drive offers no advantage for this game. A digital-only PS5, the drive-less PS5 Pro and the Xbox Series S all handle GTA 6 the same way as disc-equipped models. Second, buying boxed versus digital mostly comes down to gifting, store credit and personal preference. Third, every buyer depends on their internet connection and free storage space.


Digital preload starts at local midnight on **November 12, 2026** , one week before the November 19, 2026 launch. Preloading lets you download the game early so it unlocks instantly on release day. Because the download is large, a wired Ethernet connection is the most reliable option, as our[Wi-Fi 6E vs Ethernet comparison](https://www.newegg.com/insider/wi-fi-6e-vs-ethernet-which-connection-delivers-the-ultimate-gaming-experience-at-home-in-2026?utm_source=insider&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=insider_article_best-console-for-gta-6-ps5-ps5-pro-series-x-or-series-s-plus-which-edition-to-buy) shows. If your console sits far from the router, a modern[Wi-Fi 7 router](https://www.newegg.com/p/pl?d=wifi+7+router&utm_source=insider&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=insider_article_best-console-for-gta-6-ps5-ps5-pro-series-x-or-series-s-plus-which-edition-to-buy) or mesh system helps. Our network prep guide in this series covers that setup in depth, and our list of the[best Wi-Fi 7 routers of 2026](https://www.newegg.com/insider/best-wifi-7-routers-2026?utm_source=insider&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=insider_article_best-console-for-gta-6-ps5-ps5-pro-series-x-or-series-s-plus-which-edition-to-buy) offers specific picks.


Finally, before preload night, make sure automatic downloads are on and the console is set to download in rest mode. That way, the game finishes while you sleep.


## Pre-Launch Checklist for Your Console for GTA 6


**Lock in the console, the edition and the storage plan by early November, then preload on November 12.** Use this short checklist to stay on track.


1.


Choose your platform based on ecosystem, controller and storage needs.


2.


Pick Standard or Ultimate, knowing you can upgrade later for $20.


3.


Preorder digitally if you want the GTA+ month, and set a cancel reminder.


4.


Free up at least 150-200 GB, or add an SSD or expansion card.


5.


Confirm HDMI 2.1, 4K120, VRR and ALLM settings on your TV.


6.


Wire the console with Ethernet or upgrade your Wi-Fi before November 12.


7.


Charge controllers and consider a[gaming headset](https://www.newegg.com/p/pl?d=gaming+headset&utm_source=insider&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=insider_article_best-console-for-gta-6-ps5-ps5-pro-series-x-or-series-s-plus-which-edition-to-buy) for late-night sessions.


Next, double-check your account and payment details on the console store. A failed payment on preload night is an easy problem to avoid.


## Frequently Asked Questions


### Is the PS5 or Xbox the better console for GTA 6?


Both run the game. However, the PS5 Pro is the only model with a "Pro Enhanced" listing, and the Xbox Series X matches PS5 on 4K120 and VRR. Choose based on your friends, controller preference and existing library.


### Can the Xbox Series S run GTA 6?


Yes. GTA 6 launches on Xbox Series X|S, which includes the Series S. However, the 512 GB model has limited free space and targets lower resolutions, so plan for an expansion card.


### Does the boxed version of GTA 6 include a disc?


No. The boxed version contains a download code, not a disc. Therefore, every player downloads the game, so a disc drive offers no advantage for GTA 6.


### Is the Ultimate Edition worth it?


Choose Ultimate if you want extra single-player vehicles, weapons, styles and properties, plus bonuses like the 1995 Grotti Cheetah. The Standard Edition is the complete game, and you can upgrade later for $20.


### Is GTA 6 coming to PC?


No PC version has been announced, and there is no PC date. For now, GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026, on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S only. PC players can still check[whether their gaming PC is ready for GTA 6](https://www.newegg.com/insider/is-your-gaming-pc-ready-for-gta-6?utm_source=insider&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=insider_article_best-console-for-gta-6-ps5-ps5-pro-series-x-or-series-s-plus-which-edition-to-buy) .

## Conclusion


The best console for GTA 6 is the one that fits your space, your screen and your circle of friends. The PS5 Pro offers 2 TB of storage and the only Pro Enhanced listing. The Xbox Series X delivers full-power 4K output and Dolby Vision gaming. Meanwhile, the standard PS5 remains a strong middle ground, and the Series S works best with an expansion card.


On the edition side, Standard at $79.99 gives you the full game, but Ultimate at $99.99 adds single-player extras. Either way, plan for a download, preload on November 12, and play on November 19, 2026. For final shopping, compare[PlayStation Plus memberships](https://www.newegg.com/p/pl?d=playstation+plus&utm_source=insider&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=insider_article_best-console-for-gta-6-ps5-ps5-pro-series-x-or-series-s-plus-which-edition-to-buy) and other console accessories before launch week.
